_about: Homepage Editor's Picks (2026-10-27). Chosen by Okanagan Roam, never paid: a paid spot would be a separate row labelled Sponsored. Up to 8 picks, refreshed weekly; a pick closed for the season or not operating is skipped, and the row hides with fewer than 4. Each needs its own photo on the listing. 'why' is one short line (EN + FR).
